King's Indian is considered to be a very risky opening in general. There are certain players in the history of chess who have mastered this opening and played it with great success - Kasparov, Fischer, Nakamura and many more. It maybe time to add Javokhir Sindarov to the list. Check out this amazing game between Pragg and Sindarov with commentary by IM Sagar Shah from Clutch Chess 2026.
